brief: a warm, formulaic deep-house piece ~16 bars, canonical I-vi-IV-V-family progression, warm filtered timbres, groove + space — the proven-strength lane

rounds.code:
setcpm(30)

KICK = sound("bd*4").gain(0.9)
  .mask("<1*64>")

CLAP = sound("~ cp ~ cp").gain(0.7)
  .mask("<0@8 1*56>")

HAT = sound("hh/2 ~ hh/2 ~ hh/2 ~ hh/2 ~").gain(0.5)
  .mask("<0@16 1*48>")

BASS_RHYTHM = n("<0!2 ~ 0!2 ~>").struct("0@4")
BASS_ROOTS = n("<0 5 3 4>/4")
BASS = BASS_RHYTHM.add(BASS_ROOTS).scale("c2:major")
  .gain(0.8)
  .sine()
  .lpf(300).lpq(0.5)
  .decay(0.1).sustain(0.01)
  .mask("<0@4 1*60>")

PAD_CHORDS = n("<[0,2,4] [5,0,2] [3,5,0] [4,6,1]>").scale("c3:major").struct("0@4")
  .gain(0.6)
  .sawtooth()
  .lpf(1500).lpq(0.2)
  .attack(0.5).decay(2).sustain(0.5).release(1)
  .mask("<0@16 1*48>")

LEAD_SEGMENT = n("<4 5 7 ~ 5 4 ~ 2 0 ~>").scale("c4:major")
LEAD = LEAD_SEGMENT.add(n("<-12>").struct("0@8 1@8"))
  .gain(0.7)
  .triangle()
  .lpf(2500).lpq(0.3)
  .delay(0.5).delaytime(0.25).delayfeedback(0.4)
  .decay(0.2).sustain(0.05)
  .mask("<0@32 1@16 0@16>")

P_ALL = stack(KICK, CLAP, HAT, BASS, PAD_CHORDS, LEAD)
P_ALL
